note: Surface discriminators. These decide WHICH set of skill text is correct for a given SDK, so they run first: if one of these fails the rest of the report is about the wrong surface. X-APIMatic-Gen-Version does not pin the surface on its own — codegen-v2 has shipped differing Core trees under the same 4.0.0 string — so the file-presence checks below are the real discriminators.

assertions.claim: The options class carries a built-in logging surface (LoggingOptions).
This surface has no SdkHook — a fixture that has one is a LATER surface than the skills describe, even if it still reports 4.0.0.
assertions.defends: the core-surface stamp on every dotnet-* skill

assertions.claim: RequestOptions carries only LogLevel; a Hooks property means a later surface.
The generator stamps a version header (and treats it as log-safe).
